source: xeet.ai website + API via MCP browsing
methodology: realParticipants = users with Math.round(totalPoints) >= 1 on the tournament leaderboard. Verified that leaderboard 'Xeets' column shows tournament-specific score (totalPoints), NOT current XEET balance (xeetEarned). Cross-checked Cris (@xinsanityo): profile shows 4,448 XEETS balance, Kona leaderboard shows 315. Distribution stats (totalXeetsDistributed, avg, median, top10) computed by summing Math.round(totalPoints) for all participants with >=1.
